title: Companies (Management and Administration) Amendment Rules, 2016 — Rule 17(2) amendment

content.publisher: India Code / Government of India, Ministry of Corporate Affairs
content.citation: G.S.R. 908(E), 23 September 2016, rule 5; amendment to the Explanation to rule 17(2) of the Companies (Management and Administration) Rules, 2014
content.note: Official Gazette notification text expressly substitutes “on any day except national holiday” for “on working day” in the Explanation to rule 17(2). This is primary-source confirmation of that specific amendment only. It does not establish a fully consolidated current text of all Rule 17 sub-rules or verify all subsequent amendments; retain review status pending full rule-by-rule amendment reconciliation.
